name: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers - Post Matric (Labour Welfare Scheme (Education))
provider: Ministry of Labour & Employment (Labour Welfare Organisation)

value: iron ore/manganese ore/chrome ore mine worker
rules.quote: Either of the parents of the applicant must be a Beedi, Iron Ore, Manganese Ore, Chrome Ore Mines, Limestone, Dolomite Mines, or Cine worker with at least six months of service.
The total monthly income of the worker’s family must not exceed:

rules.value: cine workers: monthly income up to Rs 8,000 (or Rs 1 lakh lump sum); mine supervisory staff up to Rs 10,000 per month
rules.quote: Cine Workers: Monthly income not exceeding ₹8,000, or ₹1,00,000 if paid by way of a lump sum or instalments.

rules.value: passed last qualifying exam in first attempt (promoted students also eligible)
rules.quote: The applicant must have passed the last qualifying examination on the first attempt. Students promoted to the next class are also eligible.
Scholars pursuing correspondence studies are not eligible.
Applicants must have taken regular admission in recognised institutions for general or technical education (e.g., medical, engineering, agriculture).

amount.text: Per annum: ITI/Polytechnic/Degree Rs 6,000; Professional courses Rs 25,000 (school classes Rs 1,000-3,000)
amount.quote: ITI ₹6,000 Polytechnic ₹6,000 Degree Courses (including B.Sc. Agriculture) ₹6,000 Professional Courses ₹25,000

documents.name: Worker identity card (Form B register number for mine workers)
documents.quote: Identity card of the worker (Form B Register number for Mine workers)

documents.name: Income certificate from revenue authority
documents.quote: Income certificate issued by the relevant revenue authority
